about: Reworded research lines applied at ingest by scripts/lib/rewrites.mjs and to content/ by scripts/fix-research-claims.mjs.

formulation/aravindasava.from: - Pediatric digestive tonic - supported by observational studies showing improved appetite and weight gain
formulation/aravindasava.to: - Pediatric digestive tonic: traditionally used as a digestive tonic for children. Observational studies have reported improved appetite and weight gain.

formulation/aravindasava.from: - Child growth and development promotion - traditional use corroborated by nutritive and immunomodulatory mechanisms
formulation/aravindasava.to: - Child growth and development: traditionally used to promote growth and development in children.

formulation/aravindasava.from: - Childhood immunity enhancement - supported by improved IgG/IgA levels in observational study
formulation/aravindasava.to: - Childhood immunity: traditionally used to strengthen immunity in children. An observational study reported improved IgG and IgA levels.

formulation/aravindasava.from: - Childhood anemia and malnutrition - supported by Raktaprasadana (blood-enriching) properties
formulation/aravindasava.to: - Childhood anemia and malnutrition: traditionally used for anemia and malnutrition in children, based on its classical Raktaprasadana (blood-enriching) property.

formulation/arjunarishta.from: - Heart tonic (Hridya) - validated by cardioprotective studies showing reduced post-ischemic damage
formulation/arjunarishta.to: - Heart tonic (Hridya): traditionally used as a heart tonic. Studies have reported reduced post-ischemic damage.

formulation/arjunarishta.from: - Cardiac weakness and palpitations - supported by antiarrhythmic and calcium channel stabilization research
formulation/arjunarishta.to: - Cardiac weakness and palpitations: traditionally used for cardiac weakness and palpitations. Research has reported antiarrhythmic activity and calcium channel stabilization.

formulation/arjunarishta.from: - Hypertension management - corroborated by ACE inhibition and vasodilatory mechanisms
formulation/arjunarishta.to: - Hypertension: traditionally used in hypertension. Research has reported ACE inhibition and vasodilatory activity.

formulation/arjunarishta.from: - Hyperlipidemia - traditional use supported by antioxidant profile and lipid-lowering properties of [Arjuna](/herb/arjuna/)
formulation/arjunarishta.to: - Hyperlipidemia: traditionally used in hyperlipidemia. Research has reported antioxidant and lipid-lowering properties for [Arjuna](/herb/arjuna/).

formulation/amrita-ghrita.from: - Vyadhikshamatva (immunity enhancement): RCT validates 22% increase in serum [immunoglobulins](/glossary/compounds-g-l/#immunoglobulins) in elderly subjects
formulation/amrita-ghrita.to: - Vyadhikshamatva (immunity enhancement): traditionally used for enhancing immunity. A clinical study reported an increase in serum [immunoglobulins](/glossary/compounds-g-l/#immunoglobulins) in elderly subjects.

formulation/amrita-ghrita.from: - [Rasayana](/reference/rasayana/) (rejuvenation): [immunomodulatory](/reference/immunomodulatory/) and adaptogenic activities confirmed in preclinical studies supporting classical rejuvenative claims
formulation/amrita-ghrita.to: - [Rasayana](/reference/rasayana/) (rejuvenation): traditionally used for rejuvenation. Preclinical studies have reported [immunomodulatory](/reference/immunomodulatory/) and adaptogenic activities.

formulation/amrita-ghrita.from: - Jvara (fever management): [Guduchi](/herb/guduchi/)'s immunostimulant and [antipyretic](/reference/antipyretic/) activities well-validated pharmacologically
formulation/amrita-ghrita.to: - Jvara (fever): traditionally used for fever. Pharmacological studies have reported immunostimulant and [antipyretic](/reference/antipyretic/) activities of [Guduchi](/herb/guduchi/).

formulation/amrita-ghrita.from: - Ojas Vardhana (vital energy enhancement): traditional use for enhancing strength, immunity, and longevity supported by clinical evidence
formulation/amrita-ghrita.to: - Ojas Vardhana (vital energy enhancement): traditionally used for enhancing strength, immunity, and longevity.

formulation/amritottaram-kashayam.from: - Fever management (Jwara Chikitsa) - validated by immunomodulatory and antipyretic studies
formulation/amritottaram-kashayam.to: - Jwara Chikitsa (fever care): traditionally used for fever. Research has reported immunomodulatory and antipyretic activity.

formulation/amritottaram-kashayam.from: - Liver protection in mild hepatitis - supported by ALT/AST reduction in clinical study
formulation/amritottaram-kashayam.to: - Traditionally used to protect the liver in mild hepatitis. A clinical study reported lower ALT and AST levels.

formulation/amritottaram-kashayam.from: - General immunity enhancement - validated by NK cell and macrophage activation research
formulation/amritottaram-kashayam.to: - Traditionally used to support general immunity. Research has reported NK cell and macrophage activation.

formulation/amritottaram-kashayam.from: - Digestive support during febrile illness - supported by Shunthi's established digestive properties
formulation/amritottaram-kashayam.to: - Traditionally used for digestive support during febrile illness. Shunthi is traditionally valued for its digestive properties.

formulation/abhayarishta.from: - Constipation (Vibandha) - validated by double-blind study showing significant relief in 4 weeks
formulation/abhayarishta.to: - Constipation (Vibandha): traditionally used for constipation. A double-blind clinical study reported significant improvement.

formulation/abhayarishta.from: - Piles/Hemorrhoids (Arsha) - supported by venotonic and anti-inflammatory studies on [Haritaki](/herb/haritaki/)
formulation/abhayarishta.to: - Piles/Hemorrhoids (Arsha): traditionally used for piles. Studies on [Haritaki](/herb/haritaki/) have reported venotonic and anti-inflammatory activity.

formulation/abhayarishta.from: - Abdominal distension and flatulence - corroborated by cholagogue mechanism increasing bile flow
formulation/abhayarishta.to: - Abdominal distension and flatulence: traditionally used for abdominal distension and flatulence. A cholagogue action that increases bile flow has been reported.

formulation/abhayarishta.from: - Dysuria (difficult urination) - traditional use supported by [Gokshura](/herb/gokshura/)'s [diuretic](/reference/diuretic/) properties
formulation/abhayarishta.to: - Dysuria (difficult urination): traditionally used for difficult urination. [Gokshura](/herb/gokshura/) is described as having [diuretic](/reference/diuretic/) properties.

formulation/anu-taila.from: - Sinusitis and allergic rhinitis - validated by pilot study (2018) showing 40% reduction in nasal congestion scores over 4 weeks
formulation/anu-taila.to: - Sinusitis and allergic rhinitis: traditionally used for these nasal conditions. A pilot study reported lower nasal congestion scores.

formulation/anu-taila.from: - Facial paralysis (Ardita) - validated by systematic review (2016) showing 78-91% symptom relief in facial pain, speech disorder, and earache
formulation/anu-taila.to: - Facial paralysis (Ardita): used in classical practice for this condition. A systematic review reported improvement in facial pain, speech disorder, and earache.

formulation/anu-taila.from: - Respiratory protection and immune modulation - validated by COVID-19 hamster model study (2023) showing reduced viral load and lung pathology with prophylactic nasal application
formulation/anu-taila.to: - Respiratory and immune support: traditionally used for respiratory health. An animal study in a hamster model of COVID-19 reported reduced viral load and lung pathology with prophylactic nasal application.

formulation/agastya-haritaki-rasayana.from: - Tamaka Shwasa (bronchial asthma): critical review validates bronchodilatory and anti-inflammatory mechanisms for chronic asthma management
formulation/agastya-haritaki-rasayana.to: - Tamaka Shwasa (bronchial asthma): traditionally used for chronic asthma. A review has reported bronchodilatory and anti-inflammatory activity.

formulation/agastya-haritaki-rasayana.from: - Kasa (chronic cough): primary classical indication from Charaka Samhita Kasa Chikitsa validated through pharmacological studies
formulation/agastya-haritaki-rasayana.to: - Kasa (chronic cough): used in classical practice for chronic cough, as a primary indication from Charaka Samhita Kasa Chikitsa.

formulation/agastya-haritaki-rasayana.from: - Pranvaha Srotas health (respiratory channels): clinical study confirms measurable improvement in cardiorespiratory parameters
formulation/agastya-haritaki-rasayana.to: - Pranvaha Srotas health (respiratory channels): traditionally used for the respiratory channels. A clinical study reported improvement in cardiorespiratory parameters.

formulation/agastya-haritaki-rasayana.from: - Pratishyaya (allergic rhinitis/sinusitis): traditional respiratory indication supported by [immunomodulatory](/reference/immunomodulatory/) and anti-allergic properties
formulation/agastya-haritaki-rasayana.to: - Pratishyaya (allergic rhinitis/sinusitis): traditionally used as a respiratory indication for allergic rhinitis and sinusitis.

formulation/amalaki-rasayana.from: whoStatus: "Amalaki monograph in Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India (API); Amalaki Rasayana described in Charaka Samhita as official Rasayana preparation; scientific validation through pharmacognostic and phytochemical analysis published"
formulation/amalaki-rasayana.to: whoStatus: "Amalaki has a monograph in the Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India (API). Amalaki Rasayana is described in Charaka Samhita as an official Rasayana preparation. Pharmacognostic and phytochemical analyses of it have been published."

formulation/amalaki-rasayana.from: - Vayasthapana (anti-aging/rejuvenation): telomerase activation and telomere length maintenance validated in human clinical study
formulation/amalaki-rasayana.to: - Vayasthapana (anti-aging/rejuvenation): traditionally used for rejuvenation. A clinical study in humans reported telomerase activation and maintenance of telomere length.

formulation/amalaki-rasayana.from: - Hridya ([cardioprotective](/reference/cardioprotective/)): enhanced cardiac mitochondrial function and contractile performance validated in hypertrophy model
formulation/amalaki-rasayana.to: - Hridya ([cardioprotective](/reference/cardioprotective/)): traditionally used for the heart. A study in a hypertrophy model reported improved cardiac mitochondrial function and contractile performance.

formulation/amalaki-rasayana.from: - Rasayana (comprehensive rejuvenation): 2024 comprehensive review validates antioxidant, [immunomodulatory](/reference/immunomodulatory/), and anti-aging mechanisms
formulation/amalaki-rasayana.to: - Rasayana (comprehensive rejuvenation): used in classical practice for rejuvenation. A review has reported antioxidant, [immunomodulatory](/reference/immunomodulatory/), and anti-aging activity.

formulation/amalaki-rasayana.from: - DNA repair and cellular protection: clinical study confirms maintained DNA strand break repair in aged individuals
formulation/amalaki-rasayana.to: - DNA repair and cellular protection: a clinical study reported maintained DNA strand break repair in aged individuals.

formulation/agnitundi-vati.from: - Non-ulcer dyspepsia management validated in clinical study showing significant symptom reduction after 2-week treatment
formulation/agnitundi-vati.to: - Traditionally used for non-ulcer dyspepsia. A clinical study reported a reduction in symptoms.

formulation/agnitundi-vati.from: - Flatulence and bloating relief validated through demonstrated carminative and antispasmodic pharmacological properties
formulation/agnitundi-vati.to: - Traditionally used for flatulence and bloating. Pharmacological studies have reported carminative and antispasmodic properties.

formulation/agnitundi-vati.from: - Agnimandya (digestive impairment) correction validated through stimulation of gastric acid and enzyme secretion
formulation/agnitundi-vati.to: - Agnimandya (digestive impairment): traditionally used to correct impaired digestion.

formulation/agnitundi-vati.from: - Ama Pachana (toxin digestion) validated through hot potency-mediated mobilization and metabolism of accumulated toxins
formulation/agnitundi-vati.to: - Ama Pachana (toxin digestion): used in classical practice to digest accumulated toxins, an action traditionally attributed to its hot potency.

device/medicated-alkaline-thread.from: Fistula-in-ano (Bhagandara) - primary indication. Also used for hemorrhoids (Arsha), pilonidal sinus, and chronic non-healing sinuses. ICMR-validated technique. WHO recognized as a minimally invasive alternative to fistulotomy.
device/medicated-alkaline-thread.to: Bhagandara (fistula-in-ano): used in classical practice as the primary indication. Also traditionally used for Arsha (hemorrhoids), pilonidal sinus and chronic non-healing sinuses. It is described as a minimally invasive alternative to fistulotomy.

device/medicated-alkaline-thread.from: - **India (CDSCO):** Kshara Sutra is recognized as a validated Ayurvedic surgical procedure. ICMR-validated. Taught in BAMS curriculum. Regulated under AYUSH surgical practice guidelines.
device/medicated-alkaline-thread.to: - **India (CDSCO):** Kshara Sutra is recognized as an Ayurvedic surgical procedure. It is taught in the BAMS curriculum. It is regulated under AYUSH surgical practice guidelines.

formulation/bakuchi-taila.from: - Vitiligo (Shvitra/Leucoderma) repigmentation - validated by RCT (2019) showing 40% repigmentation improvement over 6 months; and by clinical study showing 80% improvement in 68% of patients with Ayurvedic formulation vs. oral PUVA
formulation/bakuchi-taila.to: - Shvitra (vitiligo/leucoderma): traditionally used for repigmentation. A randomized controlled trial reported improvement in repigmentation. A clinical study reported improvement with an Ayurvedic formulation compared with oral PUVA.

formulation/bakuchi-taila.from: - Psoriasis and chronic skin disorders (Kushtha) - supported by the anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory properties of psoralen and flavonoids confirmed in pharmacological studies
formulation/bakuchi-taila.to: - Kushtha (psoriasis and chronic skin disorders): traditionally used for these conditions. Pharmacological studies have reported anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory properties of psoralen and flavonoids.

formulation/bakuchi-taila.from: - Alopecia and hair loss - supported by traditional use and by bakuchiol's proven ability to stimulate hair follicle melanocytes and promote pigmentation
formulation/bakuchi-taila.to: - Alopecia and hair loss: traditionally used for these conditions. Studies have reported that bakuchiol may stimulate hair follicle melanocytes and promote pigmentation.

formulation/ashwagandharishta.from: - Stress and anxiety relief - validated by cortisol reduction in placebo-controlled study
formulation/ashwagandharishta.to: - Stress and anxiety: traditionally used for stress and anxiety. A placebo-controlled clinical study reported lower cortisol levels.

formulation/ashwagandharishta.from: - Chronic fatigue and debility - supported by RCT showing fatigue severity improvement
formulation/ashwagandharishta.to: - Chronic fatigue and debility: traditionally used for chronic fatigue and debility. A randomized clinical study reported improvement in fatigue severity.

formulation/ashwagandharishta.from: - Convalescence after febrile illness - corroborated by dengue recovery study
formulation/ashwagandharishta.to: - Convalescence after febrile illness: traditionally used during convalescence after febrile illness.

formulation/ashwagandharishta.from: - Vitality and reproductive health - traditional Rasayana use supported by adaptogenic and anabolic mechanisms
formulation/ashwagandharishta.to: - Vitality and reproductive health: traditionally used as a Rasayana for vitality and reproductive health.

formulation/balarishta.from: - General debility and weakness post-illness - validated by adaptogenic and nutritive mechanisms
formulation/balarishta.to: - General debility and weakness post-illness: traditionally used for general debility and weakness after illness.

formulation/balarishta.from: - Rheumatic pain and joint disorders - supported by anti-inflammatory studies in arthritis models
formulation/balarishta.to: - Rheumatic pain and joint disorders: traditionally used for rheumatic pain and joint disorders. Studies in arthritis models have reported anti-inflammatory activity.

formulation/balarishta.from: - Post-paralysis rehabilitation - traditional use corroborated by nervine tonic properties of [Bala](/herb/bala/)
formulation/balarishta.to: - Post-paralysis rehabilitation: traditionally used during recovery after paralysis. In classical practice, [Bala](/herb/bala/) is regarded as a nervine tonic.

formulation/balarishta.from: - Hemiplegia support - supported by [neuroprotective](/reference/neuroprotective/) and neurotransmitter modulation studies
formulation/balarishta.to: - Hemiplegia support: traditionally used as support in hemiplegia. Studies have reported [neuroprotective](/reference/neuroprotective/) activity and effects on neurotransmitters.

formulation/brahmi-ghritam.from: - Apasmara (epilepsy) management: validated through PTZ-induced seizure models showing significant anticonvulsant activity
formulation/brahmi-ghritam.to: - Apasmara (epilepsy): traditionally used for epilepsy. Animal studies using PTZ-induced seizure models have reported anticonvulsant activity.

formulation/brahmi-ghritam.from: - Unmada (psychosis/psychiatric disorders): clinical reviews confirm efficacy in anxiety, depression, and ADHD in children
formulation/brahmi-ghritam.to: - Unmada (psychosis/psychiatric disorders): traditionally used for psychiatric disorders. Clinical reviews have reported benefits in anxiety, depression, and ADHD in children.

formulation/brahmi-ghritam.from: - Smriti [Vriddhi](/herb/vriddhi/) (memory enhancement): double-blind studies show 20-40% improvement in memory retention and attention
formulation/brahmi-ghritam.to: - Smriti [Vriddhi](/herb/vriddhi/) (memory enhancement): traditionally used for memory enhancement. Double-blind clinical studies have reported improvement in memory retention and attention.

formulation/brahmi-ghritam.from: - CNS depressant and [anxiolytic](/reference/anxiolytic/) effects: experimental studies confirm anti-anxiety and calming properties
formulation/brahmi-ghritam.to: - CNS depressant and [anxiolytic](/reference/anxiolytic/) effects: experimental studies have reported anti-anxiety and calming properties.

formulation/bilwadi-leha.from: - Grahani (IBS): clinical trial validates 67-100% improvement across all IBS symptoms including pain, bloating, diarrhea, and mucus passage
formulation/bilwadi-leha.to: - Grahani (IBS): traditionally used for Grahani. A clinical study reported improvement in IBS symptoms, including pain, bloating, diarrhea, and mucus passage.

formulation/bilwadi-leha.from: - Atisara (diarrhea): anti-diarrheal action of Bilwa validated pharmacologically through astringent and [antimicrobial](/reference/antimicrobial/) mechanisms
formulation/bilwadi-leha.to: - Atisara (diarrhea): traditionally used for Atisara. Pharmacological studies have reported anti-diarrheal activity of Bilwa through astringent and [antimicrobial](/reference/antimicrobial/) mechanisms.

formulation/bilwadi-leha.from: - Pravahika (dysentery): traditional use supported by antimicrobial and intestinal mucosal protective properties of Bael
formulation/bilwadi-leha.to: - Pravahika (dysentery): traditionally used for Pravahika. Bael has been reported to have antimicrobial and intestinal mucosal protective properties.

formulation/bilwadi-leha.from: - Agnimandya (digestive weakness): [Trikatu](/herb/trikatu/) and carminative spices confirmed to enhance digestive enzyme activity and reduce flatulence
formulation/bilwadi-leha.to: - Agnimandya (digestive weakness): traditionally used for Agnimandya. [Trikatu](/herb/trikatu/) and carminative spices have been reported to enhance digestive enzyme activity and reduce flatulence.

formulation/arogyavardhini-vati.from: - Hepatoprotective action in fatty liver disease (NAFLD/AFLD) validated through multiple clinical and preclinical studies showing dose-dependent liver protection
formulation/arogyavardhini-vati.to: - Fatty liver disease (NAFLD/AFLD): clinical and preclinical studies have reported a dose-dependent liver-protective action.

formulation/arogyavardhini-vati.from: - [Hypolipidemic](/glossary/pharmacology/#hypolipidemic) effects confirmed in clinical trials demonstrating reduction in total cholesterol, LDL, and triglycerides
formulation/arogyavardhini-vati.to: - [Hypolipidemic](/glossary/pharmacology/#hypolipidemic) effects: clinical trials have reported reductions in total cholesterol, LDL and triglycerides.

formulation/arogyavardhini-vati.from: - Skin disease management (kushtha) supported by anti-inflammatory and blood-purifying mechanisms confirmed in dermatological studies
formulation/arogyavardhini-vati.to: - Kushtha (skin disease): traditionally used for skin conditions. Dermatological studies have reported anti-inflammatory and blood-purifying activity.

formulation/arogyavardhini-vati.from: - Digestive fire enhancement (Agni deepana) validated through improved appetite and digestive enzyme secretion in clinical observations
formulation/arogyavardhini-vati.to: - Agni deepana (digestive fire enhancement): traditionally used to kindle digestion. Clinical observations have reported improved appetite and digestive enzyme secretion.

formulation/avipattikar-churna.from: - Hyperacidity and peptic ulcer (validated by ranitidine-comparable anti-ulcerogenic studies and NF-kB pathway research)
formulation/avipattikar-churna.to: - Hyperacidity and peptic ulcer: traditionally used for hyperacidity and peptic ulcer. Studies have reported anti-ulcer activity comparable to ranitidine, along with activity on the NF-kB pathway.

formulation/avipattikar-churna.from: - Constipation relief (validated by mild laxative action of [Trivrit](/herb/trivrit/) and [Triphala](/herb/triphala/) components)
formulation/avipattikar-churna.to: - Constipation: traditionally used for constipation. Its [Trivrit](/herb/trivrit/) and [Triphala](/herb/triphala/) components are traditionally regarded as mild laxatives.

formulation/avipattikar-churna.from: - Digestive fire enhancement (validated by carminative properties of [Trikatu](/herb/trikatu/))
formulation/avipattikar-churna.to: - Digestive fire: traditionally used to strengthen digestive fire. Its [Trikatu](/herb/trikatu/) component is traditionally regarded as carminative.

formulation/avipattikar-churna.from: - Gastric mucosal protection (validated by antioxidant cytoprotective studies)
formulation/avipattikar-churna.to: - Gastric mucosal protection: traditionally used to protect the stomach lining. Studies have reported antioxidant and cytoprotective activity.

formulation/brahma-rasayana.from: - Medhya (cognitive enhancement/memory): RCTs validate 25-30% improvement in memory recall and MMSE scores over 8-16 weeks
formulation/brahma-rasayana.to: - Medhya (cognitive enhancement/memory): traditionally used for memory and cognition. Clinical studies have reported improvement in memory recall and MMSE scores.

formulation/brahma-rasayana.from: - Vayasthapana (anti-aging/longevity): antioxidant and neuroprotective mechanisms confirmed to reduce age-related neural damage
formulation/brahma-rasayana.to: - Vayasthapana (anti-aging/longevity): traditionally used for longevity and healthy aging. Studies have reported antioxidant and neuroprotective activity in relation to age-related neural damage.

formulation/brahma-rasayana.from: - Smriti [Vriddhi](/herb/vriddhi/) (memory improvement): animal studies confirm memory restorative activity potentially applicable in dementia
formulation/brahma-rasayana.to: - Smriti [Vriddhi](/herb/vriddhi/) (memory improvement): traditionally used for memory improvement. Animal studies have reported memory restorative activity.

formulation/brahma-rasayana.from: - Ojas Vardhana (vital energy): [immunomodulatory](/reference/immunomodulatory/) action (IL-2 upregulation) and [adaptogenic](/reference/adaptogenic/) effects confirmed in laboratory studies
formulation/brahma-rasayana.to: - Ojas Vardhana (vital energy): traditionally used to build vital energy. Laboratory studies have reported [immunomodulatory](/reference/immunomodulatory/) activity, including IL-2 upregulation, and [adaptogenic](/reference/adaptogenic/) effects.

formulation/ashokarishta.from: - Menorrhagia control (validated by clinical study with P<0.001 significance and ongoing 2025 RCT)
formulation/ashokarishta.to: - Menorrhagia: traditionally used for menorrhagia. A clinical study reported a significant reduction in menorrhagia.

formulation/ashokarishta.from: - Menopausal syndrome management (validated by clinical evaluation showing significant symptom improvement)
formulation/ashokarishta.to: - Menopausal syndrome: traditionally used for menopausal symptoms. A clinical evaluation reported significant symptom improvement.

formulation/ashokarishta.from: - Uterine leiomyoma-associated bleeding (validated by clinical evaluation in fibroid patients)
formulation/ashokarishta.to: - Uterine leiomyoma-associated bleeding: traditionally used for bleeding associated with uterine leiomyoma.

formulation/ashokarishta.from: - Uterine tonic and postpartum recovery (traditional use supported by pharmacological evidence of uterine smooth muscle regulation)
formulation/ashokarishta.to: - Uterine tonic and postpartum recovery: traditionally used as a uterine tonic and for postpartum recovery. Pharmacological studies have reported regulation of uterine smooth muscle.

formulation/balaswagandhadi-thailam.from: - Muscle weakness and general debility recovery - validated by RCT (2019) showing 30% pain score reduction with daily abhyanga over 4 weeks
formulation/balaswagandhadi-thailam.to: - Muscle weakness and general debility recovery: traditionally used for these conditions as daily abhyanga. A clinical study reported reduced pain scores with daily abhyanga.

formulation/balaswagandhadi-thailam.from: - Post-illness recovery and Dhatukshaya (tissue depletion) - supported by GC-MS identification (2024) of anabolic [phytosterols](/glossary/compounds-o-q/#phytosterols) and vitamin E in the formulation
formulation/balaswagandhadi-thailam.to: - Post-illness recovery and Dhatukshaya (tissue depletion): traditionally used for these conditions. A GC-MS analysis identified [phytosterols](/glossary/compounds-o-q/#phytosterols) and vitamin E in the formulation.

formulation/balaswagandhadi-thailam.from: - Neuralgia and neuromuscular pain conditions - supported by pharmacological evidence of anti-inflammatory and neuromuscular-strengthening properties from dual action of [Bala](/herb/bala/) and [Ashwagandha](/herb/ashwagandha/)
formulation/balaswagandhadi-thailam.to: - Neuralgia and neuromuscular pain conditions: traditionally used for these conditions. Pharmacological studies have reported anti-inflammatory and neuromuscular-strengthening properties linked to [Bala](/herb/bala/) and [Ashwagandha](/herb/ashwagandha/).

formulation/balaswagandhadi-thailam.from: Published in PMC, the GC-MS study identified key bioactive compounds including vitamin E, campesterol, gamma-sitosterol, beta-eudesmol, and multiple fatty acid esters, validating the presence of pharmacologically active molecules in the traditional formulation.
formulation/balaswagandhadi-thailam.to: A GC-MS study identified compounds in the traditional formulation, including vitamin E, campesterol, gamma-sitosterol, beta-eudesmol, and multiple fatty acid esters.

formulation/brihatyadi-kashayam.from: - Urinary disorders (dysuria, retention) - validated by diuretic action studies on [Gokshura](/herb/gokshura/)
formulation/brihatyadi-kashayam.to: - Urinary disorders (dysuria, retention): traditionally used for these conditions. Studies have reported diuretic action of [Gokshura](/herb/gokshura/).

formulation/brihatyadi-kashayam.from: - Urinary calculi (stones) - supported by lithotriptic effects demonstrated in experimental models
formulation/brihatyadi-kashayam.to: - Urinary calculi (stones): traditionally used for urinary stones. Experimental studies have reported lithotriptic effects.

formulation/brihatyadi-kashayam.from: - Urinary tract infections - corroborated by antimicrobial activity of combined formulation
formulation/brihatyadi-kashayam.to: - Urinary tract infections: traditionally used for these conditions. Studies have reported antimicrobial activity of the combined formulation.

formulation/brihatyadi-kashayam.from: - Respiratory conditions (adjunct use) - supported by anti-tussive and [expectorant](/reference/expectorant/) properties of [Brihati](/herb/brihati/) and [Kantakari](/herb/kantakari/)
formulation/brihatyadi-kashayam.to: - Respiratory conditions (adjunct use): traditionally used as an adjunct for respiratory conditions. Anti-tussive and [expectorant](/reference/expectorant/) properties have been reported for [Brihati](/herb/brihati/) and [Kantakari](/herb/kantakari/).

formulation/chandraprabha-vati.from: - Urinary tract disorders and cystitis (validated by in vitro anti-inflammatory studies on bladder cells)
formulation/chandraprabha-vati.to: - Urinary tract disorders and cystitis: traditionally used for urinary tract disorders and cystitis. An in vitro study on bladder cells reported anti-inflammatory activity.

formulation/chandraprabha-vati.from: - Prameha/Diabetes management (validated by [antidiabetic](/reference/antidiabetic/) animal studies and clinical evaluation)
formulation/chandraprabha-vati.to: - Prameha/Diabetes: traditionally used for prameha. Animal studies have reported [antidiabetic](/reference/antidiabetic/) activity.

formulation/chandraprabha-vati.from: - Metabolic syndrome management (validated by 2024 network pharmacology analysis)
formulation/chandraprabha-vati.to: - Metabolic syndrome: traditionally used for metabolic syndrome.

formulation/chandraprabha-vati.from: - Male reproductive health and oligospermia (validated by clinical study showing 15% improvement in sperm count and motility)
formulation/chandraprabha-vati.to: - Male reproductive health and oligospermia: traditionally used for male reproductive health and oligospermia. A clinical study reported improvement in sperm count and motility.

formulation/dashamoola-katutraya-kashaya.from: - Chronic arthritis and inflammation - validated by RCT showing CRP/ESR reduction comparable to NSAIDs
formulation/dashamoola-katutraya-kashaya.to: - Chronic arthritis and inflammation: traditionally used for chronic arthritis and inflammation. A randomized controlled clinical study reported reductions in CRP and ESR.

formulation/dashamoola-katutraya-kashaya.from: - Respiratory disorders (asthma, chronic cough) - supported by clinical trial showing 30% FEV1 improvement

formulation/srikhandasava.from: - Burning micturition and UTI - corroborated by antimicrobial activity and cooling [diuretic](/reference/diuretic/) properties
formulation/srikhandasava.to: - Burning micturition and UTI: traditionally used for these conditions. Studies have reported antimicrobial activity and cooling [diuretic](/reference/diuretic/) properties.

formulation/srikhandasava.from: - Skin conditions with burning and inflammation - supported by antioxidant and antimicrobial profiling
formulation/srikhandasava.to: - Skin conditions with burning and inflammation: traditionally used for these conditions. Studies have reported antioxidant and antimicrobial activity.

formulation/srikhandasava.from: PMC-published study confirmed high antioxidant activity through DPPH, FRAP, and ABTS assays, validating the formulation's Pitta-pacifying and tissue-protective properties.

formulation/sanjivani-vati.from: - Fever management (Jwara Chikitsa) validated through demonstrated diaphoretic and antipyretic mechanisms breaking fever cycle
formulation/sanjivani-vati.to: - Fever (Jwara Chikitsa): traditionally used for fever. Studies have reported diaphoretic and antipyretic activity.

formulation/sanjivani-vati.to: - Toxin elimination (Ama Pachana/Vishaghna): traditionally used to clear toxins. Studies have reported antimicrobial activity against Salmonella typhi and H. pylori.

formulation/sanjivani-vati.from: - Gastro-enteritis (Visuchika) management validated through combined antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and digestive-correcting actions

formulation/sanjivani-vati.to: - Immunomodulation: used in classical practice to modulate immunity. Studies on [Guduchi](/herb/guduchi/) have reported increased phagocytic activity and adaptive immune response.

formulation/sukumara-kashayam.from: - Dysmenorrhea and menstrual irregularity - validated by clinical observations showing antispasmodic and hormonal effects
formulation/sukumara-kashayam.to: - Dysmenorrhea and menstrual irregularity: traditionally used for these conditions. Clinical observations have reported antispasmodic and hormonal effects.

formulation/sukumara-kashayam.from: - Constipation and digestive disorders - supported by prokinetic action of [Dashamoola](/herb/dashamoola/) and [Eranda](/herb/eranda/) root constituents
formulation/sukumara-kashayam.to: - Constipation and digestive disorders: traditionally used for these complaints. Prokinetic action has been reported for [Dashamoola](/herb/dashamoola/) and [Eranda](/herb/eranda/) root constituents.

formulation/sukumara-kashayam.from: - Polycystic ovarian disease and uterine fibroids - partially validated by clinical case studies showing cyst size reduction
formulation/sukumara-kashayam.to: - Polycystic ovarian disease and uterine fibroids: traditionally used for these conditions. Clinical case studies have reported a reduction in cyst size.

formulation/sukumara-kashayam.from: - Infertility support - traditional use supported by phytoestrogenic activity of key ingredients
formulation/sukumara-kashayam.to: - Infertility support: traditionally used to support fertility. Phytoestrogenic activity has been reported for key ingredients.

formulation/talisadi-churna.from: - Chronic bronchitis (validated by 12-week clinical trial with significant improvements in LCQ, SGRQ, and PEFR scores)
formulation/talisadi-churna.to: - Chronic bronchitis: traditionally used for chronic bronchitis. A clinical study reported improvements in cough and lung function scores.

formulation/talisadi-churna.from: - Productive cough and sputum reduction (validated by pilot study showing reduced sputum viscosity in 2 weeks)
formulation/talisadi-churna.to: - Productive cough and sputum: traditionally used for productive cough with sputum. A pilot clinical study reported reduced sputum viscosity.

formulation/talisadi-churna.from: - Respiratory tract inflammation (validated by in vitro IL-6 and TNF-alpha inhibition studies)
formulation/talisadi-churna.to: - Respiratory tract inflammation: traditionally used for inflammation of the respiratory tract. In vitro studies have reported inhibition of IL-6 and TNF-alpha.

formulation/talisadi-churna.from: - Digestive weakness associated with respiratory conditions (validated by carminative and digestive stimulant properties)
formulation/talisadi-churna.to: - Digestive weakness associated with respiratory conditions: traditionally used as a carminative and digestive stimulant for this purpose.

formulation/triphala-guggulu.from: - Anti-obesity effects validated through systematic review and meta-analysis (2025) and molecular mechanism studies confirming PI3K/Akt pathway modulation
formulation/triphala-guggulu.to: - A systematic review and meta-analysis reported anti-obesity effects. Mechanism studies reported modulation of the PI3K/Akt pathway.

formulation/triphala-guggulu.to: - Randomized controlled trials have reported reductions in LDL-C, total cholesterol, and triglycerides.

formulation/triphala-guggulu.from: - Digestive regulation and Ama elimination validated through prebiotic effects on gut microbiome and [laxative](/reference/laxative/) action
formulation/triphala-guggulu.to: - Traditionally used for digestive regulation and Ama elimination. Studies have reported prebiotic effects on the gut microbiome and [laxative](/reference/laxative/) action.

formulation/triphala-guggulu.from: - Metabolic syndrome management supported by demonstrated effects on [glucose](/glossary/compounds-d-g/#glucose), leptin, adiponectin, and inflammatory markers in animal models
formulation/triphala-guggulu.to: - In the context of metabolic syndrome, animal studies have reported effects on [glucose](/glossary/compounds-d-g/#glucose), leptin, adiponectin, and inflammatory markers.

formulation/sukumaram-ghritam.from: - Rajonirvritti (menopausal syndrome): prospective clinical study validates significant symptom improvement over 84 days
formulation/sukumaram-ghritam.to: - Rajonirvritti (menopausal syndrome): traditionally used for menopausal symptoms. A prospective clinical study reported improvement in symptoms.

formulation/sukumaram-ghritam.from: - Yoni Roga (gynecological disorders): clinical reviews confirm efficacy in dysmenorrhea, menstrual irregularities, and pelvic pain
formulation/sukumaram-ghritam.to: - Yoni Roga (gynecological disorders): traditionally used for dysmenorrhea, menstrual irregularities, and pelvic pain. Clinical reviews have reported improvement in these conditions.

formulation/sukumaram-ghritam.from: - Vandhyatva (infertility): traditional use for fertility enhancement supported by pharmacological evidence of hormonal modulation
formulation/sukumaram-ghritam.to: - Vandhyatva (infertility): traditionally used for fertility enhancement. Pharmacological studies have reported hormonal modulation.

formulation/sukumaram-ghritam.from: - Gulma (abdominal masses): anti-inflammatory and Vata-pacifying actions validated in abdominal conditions
formulation/sukumaram-ghritam.to: - Gulma (abdominal masses): traditionally used for its Vata-pacifying action in abdominal conditions. Anti-inflammatory activity has also been reported.

formulation/trikatu-churna.from: - Digestive fire enhancement (Agni Deepana) validated through demonstrated increases in salivary amylase, gastric acid, and pancreatic enzyme secretion
formulation/trikatu-churna.to: - Agni Deepana (digestive fire enhancement): traditionally used to kindle digestion. Studies have reported increases in salivary amylase, gastric acid and pancreatic enzyme secretion.

formulation/trikatu-churna.from: - Bioavailability enhancement (Yogavahi) validated as one of the most potent natural bioenhancers, with piperine increasing absorption up to 2000% for certain compounds
formulation/trikatu-churna.to: - Yogavahi (bioavailability enhancement): traditionally regarded as a carrier that enhances other substances. Studies have reported that piperine can increase the absorption of certain compounds.

formulation/trikatu-churna.from: - Obesity management validated in 2024 placebo-controlled RCT showing significant effects on body weight parameters
formulation/trikatu-churna.to: - Obesity: a placebo-controlled clinical study reported significant effects on body weight parameters.

formulation/trikatu-churna.from: - Kapha-reducing and respiratory decongestant action validated through thermogenic and mucolytic properties of all three ingredients
formulation/trikatu-churna.to: - Kapha-reducing action: traditionally used to reduce Kapha and to clear respiratory congestion. All three ingredients are described as having thermogenic and mucolytic properties.

formulation/varunadi-kashayam.from: - Urinary stones (Mutrashmari/Urolithiasis) - validated by lithotriptic and diuretic studies and clinical trials
formulation/varunadi-kashayam.to: - Urinary stones (Mutrashmari/Urolithiasis): traditionally used for urinary stones. Studies, including clinical trials, have reported lithotriptic and diuretic activity.

formulation/varunadi-kashayam.from: - Kidney and bladder disorders - supported by anti-inflammatory macrophage studies (PMC published)
formulation/varunadi-kashayam.to: - Kidney and bladder disorders: traditionally used for kidney and bladder disorders. Studies in macrophages have reported anti-inflammatory activity.

formulation/varunadi-kashayam.from: - Obesity management - newly validated by anti-obesity research in animal models
formulation/varunadi-kashayam.to: - Obesity: animal studies have reported anti-obesity activity.

formulation/varunadi-kashayam.from: - Inflammatory conditions - supported by cytokine inhibition in THP-1 macrophage studies
formulation/varunadi-kashayam.to: - Inflammatory conditions: traditionally used for inflammatory conditions. In vitro studies in THP-1 macrophages have reported cytokine inhibition.

formulation/varanadi-ghritam.from: - Granthi (tumors/cysts): case reports validate management of lipoma and abnormal growths with [Varanadi Ghritam](/formulation/varanadi-ghritam/)-based protocols
formulation/varanadi-ghritam.to: - Granthi (tumors/cysts): traditionally used for tumors and cysts. Case reports have described [Varanadi Ghritam](/formulation/varanadi-ghritam/)-based protocols used in lipoma and abnormal growths.

formulation/varanadi-ghritam.to: - Arbuda (tumors/cancer adjuvant): traditionally used as an adjuvant for tumors. A clinical study in head and neck cancer patients reported biological response modifier activity.

formulation/varanadi-ghritam.from: - Medoroga (obesity/metabolic disorders): Lekhana and Medohara actions of ingredients validated pharmacologically
formulation/varanadi-ghritam.to: - Medoroga (obesity/metabolic disorders): traditionally used for obesity and metabolic disorders. Pharmacological studies have reported Lekhana and Medohara actions for its ingredients.

formulation/varanadi-ghritam.from: - Gulma (abdominal masses): traditional use for abdominal growths supported by channel-clearing and anti-Kapha mechanisms
formulation/varanadi-ghritam.to: - Gulma (abdominal masses): traditionally used for abdominal growths, with channel-clearing and anti-Kapha actions described in classical practice.

formulation/triphaladi-thailam.from: - Chronic headache and migraine (Shirahshula) - validated by clinical observations (2019) showing 60% patient improvement with Nasya administration over 21 days
formulation/triphaladi-thailam.to: - Chronic headache and migraine (Shirahshula): traditionally used for chronic headache, given as Nasya. Clinical observations have reported patient improvement with Nasya administration.

formulation/triphaladi-thailam.from: - Eye disorders and visual fatigue (Netra Roga) - supported by pharmacological evidence of [pterostilbene](/glossary/compounds-o-q/#pterostilbene) from Asanaka providing retinal neuroprotection, and antioxidant action of [Triphala](/herb/triphala/) on optic tissue
formulation/triphaladi-thailam.to: - Eye disorders and visual fatigue (Netra Roga): traditionally used for eye disorders and visual fatigue. Pharmacological studies have reported retinal neuroprotective activity for [pterostilbene](/glossary/compounds-o-q/#pterostilbene) from Asanaka, and antioxidant action of [Triphala](/herb/triphala/) on optic tissue.

formulation/triphaladi-thailam.from: - Premature hair greying and hair fall - supported by the antioxidant protection from [Triphala](/herb/triphala/) and [Amla](/herb/amla/)'s established hair-strengthening properties through follicular nourishment
formulation/triphaladi-thailam.to: - Premature hair greying and hair fall: traditionally used for premature greying and hair fall. [Triphala](/herb/triphala/) has been reported to have antioxidant activity. [Amla](/herb/amla/) is traditionally used to strengthen hair by nourishing the follicles.

formulation/sudarshan-churna.from: whoStatus: "Listed in Ayurvedic Formulary of India (AFI) Part I; Swertia chirata monographed in Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India (API) Part I and Indian Pharmacopoeia; HPTLC-validated biomarker methods established (mangiferin, swertiamarin, oleanolic acid)"
formulation/sudarshan-churna.to: whoStatus: "Listed in Ayurvedic Formulary of India (AFI) Part I; Swertia chirata monographed in Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India (API) Part I and Indian Pharmacopoeia; HPTLC-validated biomarker methods developed (mangiferin, swertiamarin, oleanolic acid)"

formulation/sudarshan-churna.from: - Fever management (Jwara Chikitsa) validated through pilot study showing 25% faster fever resolution compared to placebo
formulation/sudarshan-churna.to: - Jwara Chikitsa (fever care): traditionally used for fever. A pilot study reported faster fever resolution compared to placebo.

formulation/sudarshan-churna.to: - Antiplasmodial properties have been reported for Swertia chirata and [Neem](/herb/neem/).

formulation/sudarshan-churna.to: - [Antimicrobial](/reference/antimicrobial/) activity against gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria has been reported in in vitro disc diffusion assays.

formulation/sudarshan-churna.to: - Traditionally used to restore appetite and improve digestion. In classical practice this is attributed to the Agni-enhancing action of [Trikatu](/herb/trikatu/) components.

formulation/triphala-churna.from: - Digestive regulation and detoxification (Anulomana, Ama Pachana) validated through demonstrated prebiotic, prokinetic, and epithelial-restorative mechanisms
formulation/triphala-churna.to: - Digestive regulation and detoxification (Anulomana, Ama Pachana): traditionally used for digestive regulation and detoxification. Studies have reported prebiotic, prokinetic, and epithelial-restorative activity.

formulation/triphala-churna.to: - Rasayana (rejuvenative): traditionally used as a rejuvenative. Clinical and preclinical studies have reported antioxidant, [immunomodulatory](/reference/immunomodulatory/), and anti-aging activity.

formulation/triphala-churna.from: - Eye health ([Chakshushya](/herb/chakshushya/)) supported by antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects; clinical studies on anti-cataract potential ongoing
formulation/triphala-churna.to: - Eye health ([Chakshushya](/herb/chakshushya/)): traditionally used for eye health. Studies have reported antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. Clinical studies on anti-cataract potential are reported to be ongoing.

formulation/triphala-churna.from: - Oral health (Kavala/Gandusha) validated through demonstrated antibacterial activity against dental caries pathogens and reduction of gingivitis in clinical trials
formulation/triphala-churna.to: - Oral health (Kavala/Gandusha): traditionally used for oral health. Studies have reported antibacterial activity against dental caries pathogens, and clinical trials have reported reduced gingivitis.

formulation/triphala-churna.from: Validated therapeutic effects including appetite stimulation, gastric hyperacidity reduction, dental caries prevention, [antipyretic](/reference/antipyretic/), [analgesic](/reference/analgesic/), antibacterial, antimutagenic, wound healing, [hepatoprotective](/reference/hepatoprotective/), chemoprotective, and radioprotective activities.
formulation/triphala-churna.to: Studies have reported activities including appetite stimulation, reduced gastric hyperacidity, activity against dental caries, [antipyretic](/reference/antipyretic/), [analgesic](/reference/analgesic/), antibacterial, antimutagenic, wound-repair, [hepatoprotective](/reference/hepatoprotective/), chemoprotective, and radioprotective activities.

herb/agastya.from: - Anti-inflammatory use validated through inhibition of pro-inflammatory mediators and reduction of edema in animal models

herb/agastya.to: - Traditionally used as a [hepatoprotective](/reference/hepatoprotective/). Studies in hepatotoxicity models have reported lower liver [enzymes](/glossary/compounds-d-g/#enzymes) (ALT, AST).

herb/agastya.from: - Alpha-glucosidase inhibitory activity of leaf flavonoids supports traditional [antidiabetic](/reference/antidiabetic/) use
herb/agastya.to: - Traditionally used as an [antidiabetic](/reference/antidiabetic/). Research has reported alpha-glucosidase inhibitory activity in leaf flavonoids.

formulation/yogaraja-guggulu.from: - Osteoarthritis (Sandhivata) management validated through randomized clinical trials showing 35% pain reduction and significant functional improvement
formulation/yogaraja-guggulu.to: - Sandhivata (osteoarthritis): traditionally used for this condition. Clinical studies have reported reduced pain and improved joint function.

formulation/yogaraja-guggulu.from: - Musculoskeletal and nervous system disorders validated across multiple clinical observations for joint pains, gout, and rheumatoid arthritis
formulation/yogaraja-guggulu.to: - Traditionally used for musculoskeletal and nervous system disorders, including joint pains, gout, and rheumatoid arthritis.

formulation/yogaraja-guggulu.from: - Lumbar and cervical spondylosis relief supported by clinical prescribing data and patient outcome studies
formulation/yogaraja-guggulu.to: - Traditionally used for lumbar and cervical spondylosis.

formulation/yogaraja-guggulu.from: - Ankylosing spondylitis management supported by anti-inflammatory and [immunomodulatory](/reference/immunomodulatory/) mechanisms validated in pharmacological research
formulation/yogaraja-guggulu.to: - Traditionally used for ankylosing spondylitis. Pharmacological studies have reported anti-inflammatory and [immunomodulatory](/reference/immunomodulatory/) activity.

formulation/vyoshadi-guggulu.from: - Thyroid function support (Galaganda) validated in RCT showing 16.61% TSH reduction with no adverse effects over 60-day treatment
formulation/vyoshadi-guggulu.to: - Galaganda (thyroid swelling): traditionally used for thyroid conditions. A randomized controlled trial reported a reduction in TSH levels, with no adverse effects reported.

formulation/vyoshadi-guggulu.from: - Respiratory congestion and common cold (Pratishyaya) management validated through 30% improvement in cough frequency in clinical study
formulation/vyoshadi-guggulu.to: - Pratishyaya (respiratory congestion and common cold): traditionally used for congestion and colds. A clinical study reported improvement in cough frequency.

formulation/vyoshadi-guggulu.to: - Obesity: used in classical practice for excess weight. A prospective multicenter study reported on the safety and outcomes of Vyoshadi Guggulu combined with [Haritaki](/herb/haritaki/) Churna.

formulation/vyoshadi-guggulu.from: - Voice hoarseness and throat disorders validated through anti-inflammatory and mucosal-strengthening mechanisms of combined ingredients
formulation/vyoshadi-guggulu.to: - Voice hoarseness and throat disorders: traditionally used for hoarseness and throat complaints.

formulation/vasa-avaleha.from: - Tamaka Shwasa (bronchial asthma): randomized clinical study validates significant improvement in symptoms and lung function in 66 patients
formulation/vasa-avaleha.to: - Tamaka Shwasa (bronchial asthma): traditionally used for bronchial asthma. A randomized clinical study reported improvement in symptoms and lung function.

formulation/vasa-avaleha.from: - Kasa (chronic cough/bronchitis): multicenter study confirms clinical efficacy with mucolytic and [bronchodilator](/reference/bronchodilator/) properties
formulation/vasa-avaleha.to: - Kasa (chronic cough/bronchitis): traditionally used for chronic cough and bronchitis. A multicenter clinical study reported mucolytic and [bronchodilator](/reference/bronchodilator/) properties.

formulation/vasa-avaleha.from: - Raktapitta/hemoptysis (coughing blood): hemostatic (Raktastambhaka) action of [Vasa](/herb/vasa/) validated for controlling respiratory hemorrhage
formulation/vasa-avaleha.to: - Raktapitta/hemoptysis (coughing blood): [Vasa](/herb/vasa/) is used in classical practice for its hemostatic (Raktastambhaka) action in respiratory hemorrhage.

formulation/vasa-avaleha.from: - Anti-allergic respiratory action: decreased eosinophil count in clinical study confirms anti-allergic mechanism
formulation/vasa-avaleha.to: - Anti-allergic respiratory action: a clinical study reported a decreased eosinophil count, which may point to an anti-allergic action.

formulation/vidangarishta.from: - Intestinal parasites (Krimi Roga) - validated by clinical pilot showing 78% worm load reduction
formulation/vidangarishta.to: - Intestinal parasites (Krimi Roga): traditionally used for intestinal parasites. A clinical pilot study reported a reduction in worm load.

formulation/vidangarishta.from: - Abdominal bloating and flatulence - supported by digestive and carminative properties of formulation
formulation/vidangarishta.to: - Abdominal bloating and flatulence: traditionally used as a digestive and carminative for abdominal bloating and flatulence.

formulation/vidangarishta.from: - Skin abscesses and boils - traditional use corroborated by antibacterial profiling studies
formulation/vidangarishta.to: - Skin abscesses and boils: traditionally used for skin abscesses and boils. Antibacterial profiling studies have reported antibacterial activity.

formulation/vidangarishta.from: - Urinary disorders and prostate enlargement - supported by anti-inflammatory and [diuretic](/reference/diuretic/) properties of components
formulation/vidangarishta.to: - Urinary disorders and prostate enlargement: traditionally used for urinary disorders and prostate enlargement. Its components are traditionally regarded as anti-inflammatory and [diuretic](/reference/diuretic/).

herb/abhraka-bhasma.from: - Hepatitis and liver disorders: Hepatoprotective effects confirmed at therapeutic doses in animal models, validating Yakrit Roga (liver disease) indication
herb/abhraka-bhasma.to: - Hepatitis and liver disorders: traditionally used for Yakrit Roga (liver disease). Animal studies have reported hepatoprotective effects.

herb/abhraka-bhasma.from: - Respiratory diseases (Shwasa, Kasa): Anti-inflammatory and respiratory support properties demonstrated through preclinical studies on lung cancer cells
herb/abhraka-bhasma.to: - Respiratory diseases (Shwasa, Kasa): traditionally used for Shwasa and Kasa. Preclinical studies on lung cancer cells have reported anti-inflammatory properties.

herb/abhraka-bhasma.from: - Cancer management: Cytotoxicity against breast and lung cancer cell lines validates traditional use for Arbuda (tumor) conditions, though clinical translation pending
herb/abhraka-bhasma.to: - Cancer: traditionally used for Arbuda (tumor) conditions. In vitro studies have reported cytotoxicity against breast and lung cancer cell lines. Clinical translation is pending.

herb/abhraka-bhasma.from: - Rejuvenation (Rasayana): DNA repair enhancement and immunomodulatory activities support the classical Rasayana (rejuvenation/anti-aging) claims
herb/abhraka-bhasma.to: - Rejuvenation (Rasayana): used in classical practice as a Rasayana (rejuvenation/anti-aging). Studies have reported DNA repair enhancement and immunomodulatory activity.

herb/adhaki.to: - [Antidiabetic](/reference/antidiabetic/) activity: traditionally used for diabetes. In vivo studies have reported hypoglycemic effects.

herb/adhaki.from: - [Hepatoprotective](/reference/hepatoprotective/) effects validated through safety assessment studies showing protection of liver and kidney function markers
herb/adhaki.to: - [Hepatoprotective](/reference/hepatoprotective/) effects: safety assessment studies have reported protection of liver and kidney function markers.

formulation/vidaryadi-ghrita.from: - Rajayakshma (phthisis/pulmonary tuberculosis): classical primary indication supported by respiratory-protective and nutritive actions of ingredients
formulation/vidaryadi-ghrita.to: - Rajayakshma (phthisis/pulmonary tuberculosis): used in classical practice as a primary indication.

formulation/vidaryadi-ghrita.from: - Kshaya (debility/emaciation): anabolic and tissue-building properties validated pharmacologically for wasting diseases
formulation/vidaryadi-ghrita.to: - Kshaya (debility/emaciation): traditionally used in wasting diseases. Pharmacological studies have reported anabolic and tissue-building properties.

formulation/vidaryadi-ghrita.from: - Shwasa-Kasa (asthma and chronic cough): anti-inflammatory and mucosal soothing actions support respiratory use
formulation/vidaryadi-ghrita.to: - Shwasa-Kasa (asthma and chronic cough): traditionally used for asthma and chronic cough.

formulation/vidaryadi-ghrita.from: - Badhirya (hearing loss): recent case series validates broader therapeutic potential including auditory health
formulation/vidaryadi-ghrita.to: - Badhirya (hearing loss): a case series has reported its use in hearing loss.

herb/agnikarna.from: - Anti-gout and anti-arthritic (Vatarakta) - strongly validated through colchicine's FDA-approved use for acute gout and familial Mediterranean fever
herb/agnikarna.to: - Vatarakta (gout and arthritic conditions): traditionally used for gout and arthritic conditions.

herb/agnikarna.from: - Wound healing and skin diseases (Kushtha) - partially validated through [antimicrobial](/reference/antimicrobial/) and anti-inflammatory studies
herb/agnikarna.to: - Kushtha (wounds and skin diseases): traditionally used for wounds and skin diseases. Studies have reported [antimicrobial](/reference/antimicrobial/) and anti-inflammatory activity.
